title: DALL·E 2: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
description: DALL·E 2 bridges the CLIP embedding space and a diffusion decoder. A prior model maps text CLIP embeddings to image CLIP embeddings, then a diffusion decoder generates the image. This separation enables sophisticated image editing (outpainting, inpainting, image variations) by manipulating CLIP embeddings rather than pixels.
